description.en: A game studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: play the game inside the sidebar, then package it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的游戏工作室插件：在侧栏里玩自己的游戏，顺手打包发布。

plugins.name: @davidmercer0620-ai/dsh-game-preview

description.en: Run a Cocos, Godot, Unity or WeChat project and play it inside the right sidebar — window capture, input forwarding, PC/phone viewports, Web/APK packaging, bundle budgets and a QR code for device testing.
description.zh: 跑起 Cocos / Godot / Unity / 微信小游戏，在右侧栏里直接玩——窗口捕获、键鼠转发、PC/手机视口、Web/APK 封包、包体积预算，还能生成二维码手机试玩。

plugins.author: 邮差游戏工作室 / Postman Game Studio
